title: Remains found after wildfire identified as mother-of-three missing since 2019
description: A 56-year-old man is arrested after the remains of Joanne Sheen were found in London almost seven years after she went missing.

title: King Charles warns of 'existential danger' of AI falling into wrong hands
description: The comments were made at a summit in Scotland with participants from AI giants such as Nvidia, OpenAI and Anthropic.

title: Interest rates held but Bank signals rise if energy prices stay high
description: Rates are held for the sixth time in a row but the Bank of England says high energy prices make a future rise more likely.

title: Father's tribute to 'sweetest little boy' Noah Woods
description: Rhys Woods pays tribute to his three-year-old son and offers "deepest gratitude" for community support.

title: Verified video shows wreckage of Saudi fighter jet shot down over Yemen
description: BBC Verify tracks down the location of a Houthi video showing the wreckage of an F-15 they claim to have shot down.

title: Family of 'Putney pusher' suspect say he was innocent and blame police for his death
description: The family of Nicholas Brandram said there was no forensic evidence linking him to the incident.

title: OpenAI reveals six more safety issues and unveils plan to disclose incidents
description: The firm also announced a new system to track, investigate and disclose cases of models misbehaving, or "misalignment".

title: 'I can get more time': Breast cancer patient finds out she can get life extending drug
description: Patients in England with an incurable breast cancer can now access a life-extending drug on the NHS.

title: Ed Sheeran asked me to donate $2m in aid, Robert Kraft says after Macklemore backlash
description: It comes after Macklemore pledged $1m to Palestinian causes, challenging the tycoon to match the sum.
